title: Light switch refuses to turn dark when it's time
author: zhizhongpu

linked_work.relevance: Related Light Switch scheduling report; similar area but not enough to collapse this issue without the missing configuration details.
Older Light Switch behavior report referenced as related context in prior triage.

judgment.rationale: The issue says Light Switch stays light when it should turn dark, but it still does not include the configured schedule mode, times, time zone, or the machine state around the transition. Focused code review shows the scheduler depends on those exact values at startup and on each evaluation, so the missing discriminator is configuration and timing context rather than a generic request for more logs.
evidence: The body includes a screenshot, says the theme stays light instead of turning dark, and references a bug report ZIP.
The only follow-up is “turn on laptop. wait for it's time.”
src/modules/lightswitch/LightSwitchService/LightSwitchStateManager.cpp computes effective light/dark minutes from the selected schedule mode and reevaluates theme state at startup and on each tick.
No issue comment states the configured Light Switch mode, schedule times, or whether the machine was awake, locked, or resuming when the missed transition happened.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the Light Switch schedule configuration, machine-state timing, and a fresh diagnostic ZIP captured after the missed transition.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code fix cannot be chosen yet because the report does not identify which schedule mode or transition path failed, and those paths differ materially in the Light Switch service.

actions.label: Request Light Switch schedule details

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming that the theme stays light instead of switching to dark. The remaining blocker is that the issue still does not say which Light Switch mode is configured or what state the laptop was in when the scheduled transition was missed.

**Needed**
1. Please provide the exact Light Switch schedule mode, configured light time, dark time, time zone, and whether Light Switch is enabled at startup.
2. Please describe the machine state around the missed switch, including whether it was awake, locked, asleep, or just resumed.
3. Please include the full Windows edition/build from `winver`.
4. Immediately after the next missed switch, please add a comment containing `/bugreport` so the generated ZIP captures the current logs.

This will distinguish a fixed-hours scheduling defect from a startup/resume or configuration-specific transition problem.
